name: Apply Trim Finish (Spray Method)
intent: Airless spray finish coat onto primed trim. One coat per module invocation. Scenarios needing two coats list this module twice with interstage between. Spray produces a glass-smooth laydown free of brush marks — the premium finish look.
doctrine: Coat 2 (445 LF/hr) is faster than coat 1 (380 LF/hr) because the sprayer can move quicker over an already-uniform surface with no holiday-checking required. Both rates are ~4-5x the brush rates. Spray requires the wall masking from the setup module to be in place; the cleanup module removes it after the second coat.
